'''''Dendrobium aphyllum''''', commonly known as the '''hooded orchid'''<ref name="OSK">{{cite web |last1=Kalyanpur |first1=Suresh |title=''Dendrobium aphyllum'' |url=http://www.toskar.org/dendrobium-aphyllum/ |publisher=The Orchid Society of Karnataka |accessdate=1 December 2018}}</ref> or '''兜唇石斛 (dou chun shi hu)''' is a species of [[orchid]] [[Indigenous (ecology)|native]] to [[Bangladesh]], southern [[China]], the eastern [[Himalayas]], and [[Indochina]].<ref name="7of9">[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/synonomy.do?name_id=57084 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=''Dendrobium cucullatum'' in Flora of China @ efloras.org |url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=250092783 |access-date=2024-03-10 |website=www.efloras.org}}</ref>
